about: Claude Code's built-in tools whose input carries a shell command or a file path, and that the belt does not check, each with the reason. scripts/typecheck-mod.mjs reads the tools from the installed Claude Code's own declarations: a new tool with such an input that is neither checked by the belt (src/core/belt/tools.ts) nor listed here fails the check, so a new way to run commands or write files is never missed silently.

reviewed.TaskStop: its command field names the background task to stop; nothing is run
reviewed.Artifact: reads a local file to publish it; a download is saved in the session's scratchpad, elsewhere only after Claude Code asks the person
reviewed.ArtifactData: file_path names a local JSON file it reads and sends; nothing local is written
